sign_convention: trajectory ordered by time_window_min DESCENDING (farthest-from-onset first); positive tau / Sen's slope == AUROC rises toward onset == clinical faithfulness
bootstrap_resample_unit: highest identifiable unit: patient (subject_id) for EPIC/VitalDB, surgical case (case_id) for MOVER/SIS
rule: discard every minute at or before `suppress` minutes of elapsed monitoring, then apply the unchanged transported threshold and the same first-crossing definition to the remainder
note: suppress_min=0 must reproduce Table 2; that is the check that the rest of the column is comparable to it
why_not_prop_settled: B1's settled fraction classifies a case by its first crossing only, so it is a lower bound on post-suppression sensitivity, not the answer
cross_cell_note: b1b_lead_vs_operating_point.csv correlates the reported median lead with the operating point across the fifteen cells; the unit there is a cell, not a patient, so its P values are cell permutations and not bootstraps
